scope: Owner-authorized backup and verification of the existing production APP_ENC_KEY only; no key generation, rotation, production file edit, service restart, migration or cutover

productionSource.metadata: root-owned 0600; exactly one APP_ENC_KEY assignment decoding to 32 bytes
productionSource.runtimeConsistency: The source file predates the running PM2 chatforia-api process; the inspected start script loads this file with dotenv override. The in-process value was not dumped.

transferAndMacReadback.method: Existing SSH key and strict known-host verification; a temporary owner-side helper captured the validated source in memory and sent it to the Mac clipboard without printing it or writing a plaintext key file
transferAndMacReadback.destination: Apple Passwords item named Chatforia production APP_ENC_KEY
transferAndMacReadback.verification: The transfer clipboard was cleared. The owner copied the saved Apple Passwords entry; a constant-time exact comparison with a fresh production-source read passed. The helper cleared the clipboard after comparison.

iphoneRetrieval.ownerReported: The newly saved entry was present in Passwords on the owner's iPhone; the owner revealed it and reported that its full value matched the Mac entry exactly
iphoneRetrieval.universalClipboard: An attempted automated iPhone-to-Mac comparison was inconclusive: one Mac clipboard comparison failed, and the repeat found non-key content. These attempts do not establish an iPhone value mismatch; the Mac clipboard was cleared.
iphoneRetrieval.result: owner-reported second-device retrieval and full visual match; no machine byte comparison of the iPhone copy

assessment: The Apple Passwords copy of the existing production key matched the current production source exactly on Mac, and owner-reported iPhone retrieval and full visual comparison passed. This is off-host custody under sole-owner Apple Passwords control, not a second human or separate provider. Independent JWT/OAuth material retrieval and final activation-package backup remain pending.
